query:
SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total,
  SUM(CASE WHEN boiling_point IS NULL OR boiling_point = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_boiling_point,
  SUM(CASE WHEN molecular_weight IS NULL OR molecular_weight = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_molecular_weight,
  SUM(CASE WHEN family IS NULL OR family = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_family,
  SUM(CASE WHEN intensity IS NULL OR intensity = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_intensity,
  SUM(CASE WHEN volatility IS NULL OR volatility = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as missing_volatility
FROM molecules;
